skills.name: Astral Aegis
skills.description: Increases all deployed friendly units' Maximum HP by 8% while Astra commands the field.

skills.name: Starfall Judgment
skills.description: Calls down Starfall Judgment across the battlefield, dealing magical damage to all enemies and healing all friendly units.

skills.name: Gale Stride
skills.description: Boosts friendly army Movement Speed by 12% and Critical Chance by 5% across the battlefield.

skills.name: Tempest Charge
skills.description: Surges allied morale, raising friendly Attack by 32% and Speed by 25% for 8s while blasting and slowing all enemies.

skills.name: Radiant Mending
skills.description: Enhances all healing and restoration received by friendly units by 18%.

skills.name: Sanctuary Pulse
skills.description: Emits a restorative pulse across the arena, cleansing debuffs while healing and shielding all friendly units.

skills.name: Prism Sight
skills.description: Sharpens allied targeting optics, granting +10% Attack army-wide.

skills.name: Celestial Volley
skills.description: Fires piercing spectral lances across all enemies, bypassing 35% Defense and sundering enemy Defense by 20% for 6s.

skills.name: Rapid Supply
skills.description: Improves Command Energy recovery rate by 12% throughout the battle.

skills.name: Fortified Line
skills.description: Projects a tactical barrier and +30% Defense onto all active allies for 10s while restoring 20 Command Energy.
